source: Battery power must be turned on before attempting to drive this train.
target: 在尝试驾驶此列车前，必须打开蓄电池电源。

source: Close the Main Circuit Breaker to draw power from the overhead wires.
target: 合上主断路器以从架空接触网获取电能。

source: Close the passenger doors before applying power.
target: 在施加牵引力前关闭乘客车门。

source: Raise the Pantograph and close the Main Circuit Breaker to draw power from the overhead wires.
target: 升起受电弓并闭合主断路器，从接触网获取电源。

source: Release the Parking Brake before applying power.
target: 牵引供电前，请先缓解停放制动。

source: Set the Compressor to ON to charge the air system before raising the pantograph.
target: 升起受电弓前，将空气压缩机设为“开”以对气动系统充气。

source: Set the Compressor to ON to charge the air system before using the Train Brake.
target: 使用列车制动前，将空气压缩机设为“开”以对气动系统充气。

source: Set the Reverser away from OFF to activate this cab.
target: 将换向手柄移出“关”档以激活此驾驶室。

source: Set the Throttle to OFF to release the traction lock.
target: 将牵引手柄设为“关”以解除牵引锁定。

source: Set the Train Brake handle to RUNNING before applying power.
target: 牵引供电前，将列车制动手柄设为“运行”位。

source: Set the direction of travel to FORWARD or REVERSE before applying power.
target: 牵引供电前，将运行方向设为“前进”或“后退”。

source: The Main Circuit Breaker has unexpectedly opened.
